title: Find a formation equation
hints: Look for one mole of product.
Nitrogen and hydrogen are diatomic in their reference states.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: The target is one mole of ammonia from $\ce{N2(g)}$ and $\ce{H2(g)}$.

explanations: It produces one mole from element reference states.
This produces two moles of the compound.
Atomic gases are not the elemental reference states.
